# OpenSID: experiment summary (generated by `python -m opensid.aggregate`)

Columns are `bucket/metric` on the TEST period. `±` = std over 3 seeds. `-` = not available. CCD (beta, quota) is selected on the validation period: headline = overall NDCG@10 (`ccd_overall`), cold-favouring = mean of warm & cold NDCG@10 (`ccd_balanced`).

## Cold-share-aware operating points (CCD / fusion weight selected on VALID by each rule)

Overall NDCG@10 = (1-pi) warm + pi cold, pi = share of cold targets. Selecting on overall valid N@10 assumes the valid cold share, which is far below the test one. The prior rules plug in a forecast pi_hat computed from the validation period only; the oracle uses the true test share. Seed 2026.
